separation.method: joint native layer-local delta plus optional history-conditioned ridge value
separation.model_profile: native intervention/write/readout/parameter dependency and dtype contracts
separation.benchmark_profile: ordered requests, native training examples and evaluation semantics
separation.execution_profile: logical batch size, microbatch, candidate budget, resources and evaluation schedule
separation.current_instance: Llama3-8B-Instruct / CounterFact / BS100x20 / 2k / arms A and B only

logical_batch.B_t: actual positive request count in this batch, derived at runtime
logical_batch.last_partial_batch: process all remaining requests at actual B_t; no drop or fake requests
logical_batch.microbatch: physical row partition only; does not change logical loss, Q coupling, Adam or write boundaries
logical_batch.reason_results_can_differ: request coupling and sequential history boundaries change with logical batch size

required: all ordered eligible edit sites and layer-specific d_in/d_out
native intervention site and anchor lookup positions
validated additive displacement map to each actual write parameter
native NLL readout including norm/head and target-token reduction
native norm/clamp/loss coefficients and optimizer profile
key extraction/context pooling and model-specific C0 assets
position/RoPE/mask/KV layout and cache capability conditions
model_adapter.valid_reference_required: full forward at native intervention sites and same layer-local writer
model_adapter.missing_valid_write_map: adapter/method extension required; do not claim supported
model_adapter.shared_write_parameters: require an alias-aware consistent write rule across all eligible invocations; cache fallback alone cannot make independent per-site writers valid

benchmark_adapter.native_training: variable rewrite and KL row groups per request, with explicit native per-row and per-group weights
benchmark_adapter.anchor: native profile-defined position; do not assume every task has a CounterFact subject
benchmark_adapter.key_rows: native target-free or profile-defined key inputs and original pooling semantics
benchmark_adapter.evaluation: named benchmark families, actual row identities and desired target/metric definitions
benchmark_adapter.denominators: count actual benchmark rows/targets; never hardcode 2 paraphrases or 10 neighbors
benchmark_adapter.conflicts: benchmark-declared claim identity and version/supersession rules; no automatic dedup
benchmark_adapter.baseline_input_equality: same model+benchmark native profile; no extra curriculum or evaluation leakage

geometry_backends.dual_small_B: factor A_l; T=A_l^-1 K_l; S=I+K_l.T T; right solve P=T S^-1; E=S^-1 via small factor solve
geometry_backends.primal_large_B: factor A_l+K_l K_l.T; blocked RHS for P or matrix-free E action
geometry_backends.implicit_E_action: E X = X-K_l.T solve(A_l+K_l K_l.T,K_l X)
geometry_backends.policy_output_tiling: G=(E D_l.T).T/s_l_squared with exact output-column tiles
geometry_backends.tile_request_accumulation: each KX and KK.T includes all actual B_t requests before solve/update/write
geometry_backends.exact_means: same algebra; finite-precision routes require residual/gradient qualification, not bitwise equality
geometry_backends.cancellation: monitor near-Q=I implicit subtraction; qualified dual or direct reference fallback
geometry_backends.memory_guarantee: finite resource limits still apply; do not silently split logical batch or drop layers

capabilities.causal_prefix_cache: only nodes proven independent of every current delta; actual first-intervention operation boundary
capabilities.KL_future_prune: only positions outside all KL readout dependencies, retaining original tokenization
capabilities.fused_entry_key_capture: only matching causal token prefixes/positions/pooling with runtime parity
capabilities.layer_streaming_writer: only valid dependency order and alias-safe materialized full-token propagation
capabilities.prewrite_history_key_reuse: only own/later writes do not affect the captured module input; otherwise recapture final keys
capabilities.unsupported_cache: same-objective full reference forward and native key recapture
capabilities.shared_parameter_aliases: inspect all invocations before cache/writer/history reuse; topological layer number alone is insufficient
capabilities.model_support_vs_cache_support: missing cache proof disables an optimization; missing a valid native local write map requires an adapter
